messages.english: Export saved field layouts for Google Earth.
messages.translation: Romela meralo e bolokiloeng ea masimo bakeng sa Google Earth.
Design Studio → Ho lema → Diboloko tsa masimo

messages.english: Choose one field or all fields, then download the saved boundaries, beds and path lines as KML. Labels are optional; map-reference locations are not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: Kgetha tsimo e le nngwe kapa masimo ohle, ebe o jarolla meedi e bolokiloeng, libethe tsa temo (beds) le mela ya ditsela jwaloka KML. Mengolo ya mabitso ke ya kgetho; dibaka tsa tshehetso ya mmapa hase meedi e lekantsweng ka tlhahlobo ya lefatshe (survey).
